test_cases.name: Integer Boundary Overflow
test_cases.description: Verifies Integer.MAX_VALUE + 1 wraps correctly to Integer.MIN_VALUE without arithmetic exception.

test_cases.name: Division by Zero Floating-Point IEEE 754
test_cases.description: Verifies 1.0 / 0.0 results in positive Infinity and 0.0 / 0.0 results in NaN without crashing VM.

test_cases.name: DirectGraphics ARGB 32-bit Transparent Blit
test_cases.description: Verifies drawPixels with TYPE_INT_8888_ARGB applies transparency flag accurately without solid color fill.
test_cases.expected_result: Translucent pixels blend with canvas background

test_cases.name: Sprite Pixel-Level vs Bounding-Box Collision
test_cases.description: Verifies collidesWith(Sprite, true) evaluates transparent pixel boundaries rather than solely outer rectangle.
test_cases.expected_result: True only on overlapping non-zero alpha pixels

test_cases.name: RMS Record Deletion and Compaction
test_cases.description: Verifies deleting a record in the middle of a store does not corrupt remaining record indices or enumeration.
test_cases.expected_result: getNumRecords decrements; remaining record IDs remain accessible

test_cases.name: MMAPI Player Disposal on MIDlet Context Destroy
test_cases.description: Verifies active audio players are automatically stopped and media resources cleaned up on context disposal.
test_cases.expected_result: No audio line leak or native thread hang

test_cases.name: JSR-75 Path Traversal Directory Sandboxing
test_cases.description: Verifies attempting to access ../../etc/passwd or ../../Windows fails with SecurityException or IOException.
test_cases.expected_result: Access strictly confined within virtual root

test_cases.name: Micro3D Affine Fixed-Point Precision
test_cases.description: Verifies 4096-based fixed-point identity matrix maintains unit scale across successive transformations.
